report_title: # P0039 ARC12 All-Training Development Baseline-40 Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned, failure-inclusive P0039 packet establishes an all-training development baseline for the unchanged P0037 generic compatibility controller on a newly frozen filename-only 20 ARC-AGI-1 plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 cohort. The roster was committed at f1e9f94b33f899b9e9ec94436ea1951bdf5b7050 before any selected task grid was parsed, visualized, scored, or used for further operator design; selection used only benchmark labels, split names, filenames, and opaque source-byte checksums. It excludes every historical import and all prior frozen roster imports through P0038, including P0038 transfer and P0036/P0037 development reuse. No new 20-task ARC-AGI-2 evaluation-split cohort remains after prior disjoint measurements, so this packet is explicitly all-training-split and is not independent transfer evidence. The frozen controller and generic operator vocabulary are byte-identical to P0037. P0038's immutable 1/50 fresh all-training-subset result is experimental context only and does not alter this packet. The live controller receives only each task's visible demonstrations and test input. It receives no task ID, cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or test output before committing a complete grid. This result cannot retune the frozen controller or its vocabulary. Any positive result is limited development evidence, not an ARC-AGI-1 or ARC-AGI-2 solver claim.

prior_transfer_reference.comparison_boundary: P0038 is immutable fresh all-training-subset transfer evidence on a disjoint cohort. P0039 is a later exposed development baseline on another disjoint cohort; it cannot retrospectively alter P0038 and P0039 cannot be treated as fresh transfer evidence.

implementation_reference.comparison_boundary: P0037 supplied the unchanged cross-reflection generic vocabulary. P0037 is exposed development evidence on its own different cohort; its score is implementation provenance only, not a P0039 baseline denominator or transfer comparator.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: P0037's exposed development evidence informed the frozen generic vocabulary and P0038 supplied immutable transfer context, but no selected P0039 task payload or target was available during that work. The controller implementation imports, parses, calls, and receives none of the GT feature records or GT solver code.

synthetic_contract.coverage: The frozen cross-reflection family dynamically rederives a structural cross, active quadrant, background, and payload color while refusing competing payloads and background separators.

visual_contract.coverage: The renderer keeps ARC black and magenta distinct and uses readable labels for central-separator and cross-reflection operators.
